title: Hubble Launched Blurry Because of an Error Smaller Than a Hair

scenes.text: NASA launched a telescope that could not focus.
In 1990, Hubble's first pictures came back blurry.
Its main mirror was ground wrong by about two microns.
That is roughly one fiftieth the thickness of a human hair.
So in 1993, astronauts spent five days on spacewalks, 35 hours outside, to fix it.
The fix was ten coin-sized mirrors, working like glasses.

description:
Hubble's main mirror was ground wrong by about two microns, roughly one fiftieth of the thickness of a human hair, so its first pictures in 1990 were blurry.
In 1993 astronauts fitted corrective optics during five spacewalks.
Could you spot a flaw that small? Comment below.
